snippet.title: Zombie In The City (ZombMe World 7 trailer)
snippet.description: Footage from World 7 of my independently built video game, ZombMe.  I just reached the half-way point of implementation (Worlds 1, 2, 5, and 7 are done), so I thought I'd make another trailer.  All footage is just from World 7.
